contract.classification: Categories are observed through fresh live sandbox lookups AND calls, warning capture, and nontrivial result/effect probes. Source registration membership is an independent completeness check, never the category oracle.
contract.real: Real handler or working option/variable storage; does NOT claim every signature, coordinate unit, or callback context is compatible.
contract.stub: Placeholder emits an is-not-implemented warning on the fresh state's first lookup/call. A second call being quiet does not make it silent.
contract.silent: Inert constant, identity, prefix-only, or no-op placeholder, with zero warnings on first use. Includes the URI/encoding cluster explicitly required by the amended plan.
contract.absent: No accessible member. Nil reads are included: calling/indexing/arithmetic with them fails. Unset user g/b variables are instead tested by storage roundtrip.
contract.reachability: Earliest applicable tier among load, core, optional; context names further optional/version/error-only sites. core includes all default normal/visual mappings and their timers, not just the narrower proposed behavior cases.
contract.owningTest: test/unit/lua/plugin-api-demand.test.ts: plugin API-demand audit mini.<name>; category cases are parameterized by every demand name; source sites retain duplicate same-line references.
contract.scope: Fixed two-module fixture installation. No optional nvim-treesitter package is installed; its guarded require edges are recorded, not treated as audited upstream source. No plugin behavior suite is authorized.
contract.miniComment: echasnovski/mini.comment remains ref main: reproducibility defect flagged, not changed. No repin or behavior-spec migration in this user-authorized audit.
contract.registryBaseline: Phases 1-4 changed fn totals to 92 real registrations and 39 effective declared placeholders (131 total). Historical 84/46/130 duplicate-registration controls are reconstructed explicitly, not asserted against current source. Two system-execution registrations reject intentionally rather than emit a warning; they are not mislabeled as silent placeholders.
contract.excludedConstants: Current handle 0, winnr's one-window ordinal, ui.progress_status's empty no-progress result, detached ui.open handle, and write-through file flush are intentional host models. Namespace iter/snippet placeholders are superseded by later real injections. coroutine.isyieldable's compatibility fallback is outside vim.* and does not authorize synchronous key input. Generic api/fn/namespace fallbacks warn on first use and are not extra silent entries.
